name: Catedrala Mântuirii Neamului

sources.label: Esri World Imagery — private outline/roof comparison; no imagery published

improvements: Refreshed the full irregular cathedral outline from OSM without reducing its apses and arm returns.
Ground collision follows the source polygon rather than strips through its recesses.
remainingGaps: Material height discrepancy remains: the nave is 41.4 m in the model versus the mapped 52 m primary outline.
Mapped secondary 71/72/78 m parts and the 127.05 m upper envelope are not fully reconciled with the existing decorative model reaching 133.04 m.
The source also has an inconsistent 4 m dome part; this was recorded rather than used to invent a correction.
Neighbour overlap, terrain support and tourist-scene context need the separate district/scene pass; isolated model pictures do not establish complete parity.

checks.label: Full source boundary and replacement-identity checks
checks.details: tools/landmarks/bucharest-source-check.mjs: 1 authored source rings; explicit replacement IDs match the source ledger. Entire 33-model check passes 306 checks.

checks.label: Finite geometry and collision regression
checks.details: tools/landmarks/geometry-check.mjs: all 61 models pass finite geometry, normals and triangle accounting; dedicated concave courtyard, roof and height-band checks pass.

checks.label: Mandatory foot / driving regression
checks.details: Immutable production ef21d14: npm run harness -- --scenario=foot,a --city=bucharest completed 0 high / 0 medium / 1 low (software-GL FPS only). Both scenario screenshots inspected.

checks.label: Published game studies inspected
checks.details: Front, top and oblique game-only studies inspected against source outlines and available independent reference photographs. Remaining shape discrepancies are listed explicitly.

checks.label: Matched exterior Street View comparison
checks.details: Requested outdoor panorama did not reliably provide a matched visible exterior (wrong nearby view, indoor imagery, occlusion or unavailable coverage); this is not treated as an exterior pass.

checks.label: Complete district / traffic / mirror budget
checks.details: These are isolated model studies. Paired Romana samples had unchanged findings and world-only peak1.13M triangles/296 calls, with an Arnia capture timeout; traffic and mirror budget and all tourist-scene placements require the district lanes.
